projects.title: V7
projects.description: A cinematic AI-generated product advertisement created for V7 — dynamic product-focused environments, creative camera movement, premium lighting and high-impact visual storytelling.
projects.overview: V7 needed a launch film that would make a new blue soda feel inevitable. We built the campaign around the pour itself — turning a single product moment into a full cinematic environment.
projects.creativeDirection: The creative direction centres on velocity and clarity. A hyper-saturated blue palette, controlled studio lighting and a camera that never stops moving, engineered to make the liquid feel alive.
projects.visualApproach: Every frame is product-first. Dynamic environments, refraction on liquid surfaces, and deep contrast give the soda a weight that reads premium at first glance.
projects.production: Scenes were generated, art-directed and composited in a fully AI-driven pipeline, then graded to a precise cinematic colour language.
projects.finalResult: A high-impact product commercial built for broadcast and social — engineered to stop the scroll and hold attention.

projects.title: Mercure
projects.description: An open-worked luxury watch suspended in a dark cinematic environment — precision lighting, mirrored surfaces and slow camera choreography.
projects.overview: The brief was to make precision feel dramatic. We built a single continuous shot around a skeleton movement, letting the mechanics become the story.
projects.creativeDirection: Dark, quiet and expensive. The watch holds the centre of the frame while light moves across the structure like a slow reveal.
projects.visualApproach: Reflections, depth of field and carefully placed highlights turn the product into a sculpture rather than an object.
projects.production: Full 3D build of the case and movement, cinematic lighting rigs and a camera path designed around the geometry of the piece.
projects.finalResult: A luxury product film that reads like a commercial for a heritage brand — calm, precise and impossible to ignore.

projects.title: Arpège
projects.description: A fragrance storyboard brought to life — light, glass and atmosphere choreographed into an AI-driven visual campaign.
projects.overview: Fragrance sells atmosphere, not liquid. We designed a visual world around diffusion, warmth and the weight of a single bottle.
projects.creativeDirection: Warm amber tones, drifting light and generous negative space — the campaign speaks in silence and detail.
projects.visualApproach: Glass refraction, soft volumetric light and slow camera moves that give the product a ceremonial presence.
projects.production: Concept storyboarded, then generated and art-directed scene by scene through an AI visual pipeline.
projects.finalResult: A campaign system with enough variants to run across broadcast, feeds and digital out-of-home.

projects.title: Veloce
projects.description: A technical interior film for a performance vehicle — material detail, interface light and precision camera work.
projects.overview: An exploration of how digital surfaces feel in a car interior. The film treats every material, stitch and screen as a designed object.
projects.creativeDirection: Low light, high detail. The interior becomes a stage for technology — movement measured, controlled and intentional.
projects.visualApproach: Macro material shots, animated interface elements and a camera that moves with the architecture of the cabin.
projects.production: 3D scene reconstruction and animation, with integrated screen graphics and cinematic grading.
projects.finalResult: A technical visual film that communicates the intelligence of a product without a word of dialogue.

projects.title: Coffee
projects.description: A splash-driven beverage commercial — liquid dynamics, energy and brand colour pushed to cinematic extremes.
projects.overview: Coffee is fuel. We turned a single splash into a high-energy hero moment built around texture and momentum.
projects.creativeDirection: Bold, physical and immediate. Colour carries the brand; motion carries the energy.
projects.visualApproach: High-speed liquid simulation, rich browns against deep contrast, and a hero frame engineered for impact.
projects.production: AI-generated motion sequences composited with fluid dynamics and graded to a punchy commercial palette.
projects.finalResult: A broadcast-ready commercial built to feel bigger than its production budget.

projects.title: Burger
projects.description: A product animation built around appetite — heat, texture and detail choreographed into an addictive loop.
projects.overview: Appetite is an emotion. We staged the burger like a hero product: steam, sear and structure in every frame.
projects.creativeDirection: Warm, close and indulgent. The most satisfying angle wins; everything else gets cut.
projects.visualApproach: Close macro texture work, controlled steam particles and a slow hero rotation that sells the build.
projects.production: Generated and art-directed through the AI pipeline, then composited with practical-motion references.
projects.finalResult: A campaign loop built to perform everywhere — menus, feeds, and out-of-home screens.

projects.title: Crispy
projects.description: An explosion-driven food commercial — crunch made cinematic through high-energy product action.
projects.overview: Crunch is a sound effect you can see. We built the film around one explosive moment and let everything support it.
projects.creativeDirection: Big, fast and satisfying. Movement replaces dialogue and impact becomes the message.
projects.visualApproach: Particle action, dramatic lighting and a camera that recoils with the energy of the scene.
projects.production: AI-generated action scenes composed with simulation-driven debris and commercial grading.
projects.finalResult: A short-form commercial engineered for social platforms and high-retention loops.
